connects_to_e0_e2: the roadmap sets OCD as a 'cortico-striatal-thalamic loop as a pathological limit-cycle / stuck attractor' that 'needs E1 + E2'. This map DECOMPOSES the threshold-frame engagement: the INSTANTANEOUS CSTC excitability axis is reached by the L1/L2/L3 levers (the serotonergic/dopaminergic-drive, glutamate-excitatory and sparse inhibitory-restore surfaces) while the LOCK (pathological-stabilisation) axis is NAMED out-of-reach (the DLGAP3/SLITRK5/PTPRD/BTBD3 circuit-fixation machinery). It re-derives no rule and adds no constant -- the OCD counterpart of the sec.36 addiction and sec.38 Alzheimer's partial-fits, but with a STABILISATION / LOCK dominant axis (the fourth partial fit, and an E0 STABILISATION -- the THIRD distinct E0 mode, completing the trio addiction GAIN -> Alzheimer's DECAY -> OCD STABILISATION; the E2 hysteresis / E0 consolidation dynamics layer).
disorder_level_sign: the INSTANT axis is the instantaneous CSTC-loop excitability operating point; its corrective sign is MIXED/SPLIT -- RESTORE the deficient serotonergic drive (L3, SSRI first-line) and inhibition (L2, sparse GABAergic), REDUCE the dopaminergic drive (L3, antipsychotic augmentation) and the glutamatergic drive (L1, glutamate-modulator) -- the second split-sign reachable surface in the series (after Alzheimer's). But the sign is PARTIAL: it reaches the INSTANTANEOUS surface only -- where the mainstay treatments genuinely, partially help -- and does NOT unstick the loop; the DOMINANT LOCK (pathological-stabilisation) axis is out of reach (an over-deep basin / hysteresis, not a fold). So unlike the clean fold-moving sign of the five clean-fit disorders, OCD's engagement with the threshold frame is partial [L], and the loop-lock is the E2/E0 dynamics layer's variable, an E0 STABILISATION (the third distinct mode).

INSTANT.lever_axes_drawn_from: L3 serotonergic/dopaminergic drive (SLC6A4/HTR2A/HTR1B RESTORE, DRD2 REDUCE) + L1 glutamatergic excitatory (SLC1A1/GRIN2B/GRIK2, REDUCE) + L2 inhibitory restore (GABRA1, SPARSE, RESTORE)
INSTANT.sign: MIXED/SPLIT: RESTORE the serotonergic tone (L3, SSRI) and inhibition (L2), REDUCE the dopaminergic drive (L3, augmentation) and the glutamatergic drive (L1, glutamate-modulator) -- the SSRI / antipsychotic-augmentation / glutamate-modulator DIRECTIONS; this is the INSTANTANEOUS surface, reached (and where the mainstay treatments genuinely, partially help)

LOCK.axis: pathological stabilisation / stuck-attractor lock-in (the over-deep basin / hysteresis holding the CSTC limit-cycle -- the DOMINANT OCD fault)
LOCK.why_not: the pathological STABILISATION / LOCK -- the over-consolidated, self-sustaining compulsive loop (the corticostriatal circuit-FIXATION machinery DLGAP3/SAPAP3, SLITRK5, PTPRD, BTBD3) -- is out of reach in three senses: it is NOT a fold (the ADHD lesson: a lever moves a set-point, not the DEPTH of a basin) AND it is a CONSOLIDATED/LEARNED plasticity variable -- an E0-layer trace, not an instantaneous operating point (the addiction lesson, the roadmap's 'needs E1 + E2') AND it is a pathological STABILISATION / LOCK -- an over-deep basin / hysteresis (an E2 state-switching phenomenon), the THIRD distinct E0 mode, distinct from addiction's E0 GAIN and Alzheimer's E0 DECAY. So even the instantaneous levers that nudge the operating point cannot directly UNSTICK the loop (that is the E2/E0 dynamics domain -- the convergence point, where a deep-brain-stimulation dynamics intervention acts). The threshold frame reaches it only INDIRECTLY. Named genes: DLGAP3 / SLITRK5 / PTPRD / BTBD3 (out_of_reach_targets).

lever_distribution_witness.reading: OCD is L3-DOMINANT WITH L1 STRONG AND L2 SPARSE (L3=4 serotonergic/dopaminergic-drive levers; L1=3 glutamate-excitatory; L2=1 inhibitory-restore, SPARSE) -- the NINTH distribution pattern: bipolar leaned on L1 (calcium), epilepsy on L1+L2 (the M-current), depression on L3 (HPA/monoamine), schizophrenia on L1+L3 co-dominant, autism on L1-dominant with a sparse L3, ADHD on L3-ONLY (L1/L2 EMPTY), addiction on L3-dominant with L1/L2 (excess reward drive) and Alzheimer's on L3-dominant with L1/L2 and a split sign. OCD is DISTINCT in two ways: (1) the L2 inhibitory-restore arm is SPARSE -- a single weak node, where addiction had two and Alzheimer's three (OCD's GABAergic arm is thin, itself a finding); (2) the out-of-reach axis is the FIRST that is a pathological STABILISATION / LOCK -- an over-deep basin / hysteresis, the THIRD distinct E0 mode, neither addiction's GAIN nor Alzheimer's DECAY, completing the trio.

levers.L1: REDUCE the inward excitatory / damp the glutamatergic drive of the hyperactive CSTC loop. PRESENT for OCD (3 levers): orbitofrontal-striatal hyperactivity rides an elevated glutamatergic tone, the strongest OCD candidate gene is the EAAT3 glutamate transporter (SLC1A1), and the glutamate-modulator direction (riluzole / memantine / N-acetylcysteine) REDUCES that drive (as a DIRECTION). Reaches the INSTANTANEOUS CSTC excitability; the pathological loop-LOCK itself is out of reach. The mechanism link is [O]
levers.L2: RESTORE the outward / GABA-A inhibitory current -- a SPARSE, single, weak node. PRESENT but SPARSE for OCD (1 lever): reduced cortical GABA is reported in OCD and clonazepam is an adjunct, but the inhibitory-restore arm of OCD is THIN (one weak node, where addiction had two and Alzheimer's three) -- itself a finding. Reaches the INSTANTANEOUS inhibitory balance only. The mechanism link is [O]
levers.L3: RESTORE/rebalance a deficient UP-STREAM serotonergic DRIVE and REDUCE an excess dopaminergic drive. The DOMINANT lever class for OCD (4 levers): the serotonergic system is the established first-line (the SSRI / clomipramine direction RAISES serotonergic signalling -- SLC6A4/SERT, the 5-HT2A and 5-HT1B receptors), and antipsychotic AUGMENTATION (the DRD2 direction) REDUCES the dopaminergic drive in refractory / tic-related OCD. This reaches the INSTANTANEOUS up-stream drive ONLY; the pathological loop-LOCK (the LOCK axis) is out of reach (partial fit [L]). The mechanism link is [O]

maps_ocd_substrate: the CSTC-loop substrate (the cortico-striato-thalamo-cortical worry-compulsion loop) establishes OCD as a disorder of a STUCK, self-sustaining, over-consolidated limit-cycle: orbitofrontal-striatal hyperactivity settles into a pathologically stabilised attractor, reinforced by the transient anxiety-relief each compulsion delivers. This map re-cuts that substrate by threshold-frame REACHABILITY -- the up-stream serotonergic/dopaminergic DRIVE (L3, dominant), the glutamatergic EXCITATORY axis (L1, strong) and a SPARSE inhibitory-restore arm (L2) are the reachable lever surface (where the mainstay treatments genuinely, partially help); the pathological STABILISATION / LOCK (the LOCK axis) is out of reach -- adding NO new mechanism and NO new constant.

out_of_reach_targets._what: the LOCK-axis (pathological-stabilisation) genes a threshold/drive lever CANNOT reach -- named to make the OCD partial-fit CONCRETE. Each carries a gamma read (its own promoter switch stiffness) ALONGSIDE, but is explicitly NOT a lever: the pathological STABILISATION of the CSTC limit-cycle (the over-consolidated, self-sustaining compulsive loop -- the corticostriatal circuit-FIXATION machinery DLGAP3/SAPAP3, SLITRK5, PTPRD, BTBD3) is not a fold, is a CONSOLIDATED/LEARNED plasticity (E0-layer) variable and is a pathological STABILISATION / LOCK (an over-deep basin / hysteresis, an E2 phenomenon), so the threshold frame has no direct handle. This is the DOMINANT OCD fault -- the loop-lock that makes the compulsion self-sustain, and the dynamics axis (where deep-brain stimulation of the CSTC loop acts) -- which is exactly why OCD is a PARTIAL fit (the dominant axis is the out-of-reach one) and the THIRD distinct E0 mode.
